slides.title: Plate acceptance and control validity
slides.subtitle: Copy of Brindlewythe assay-control training | Working copy 09/24/2024

slides.title: Purpose of this session
bullets: Who signs off a plate before its data are used
What makes a control valid for each in vitro package
What to do when a plate fails, and who has to be told
slides.notes: KM: Brindlewythe plate acceptance wording retained for discussion. Lucia: map acceptance decisions to Osterquill control validity and the investigation plan before local use.

slides.title: Control validity: the basics
bullets: Each assay run includes the controls required by its approved investigation plan or SOP
Control validity is judged against criteria fixed before results are reviewed

bullets.text: Plate acceptance applies to plate assays; culture and electrophysiology records have their own acceptance checks

bullets: Data from a run with invalid controls are not used for a safety conclusion

bullets.text: Vehicle and cell-free wells on every plate
Strain-specific positive controls with and without S9

bullets_right.text: Concurrent vehicle and appropriate positive controls; assess cytotoxicity and scoring eligibility
Reference response and assay-specific suitability checks; hERG patch-clamp records are not plate-reader maps

slides.title: Plate acceptance on the day
bullets: Check the vehicle wells against the range in the study plan before reading the test wells
Check the reference compound response against its own range
Record the plate ID and the reader settings on the observation sheet

bullets.text: Initials and date on every printed plate map

slides.notes: KM: The vehicle range wording is from the old SOP. Confirm with Lucia before this version is reused.

boxes: Control outside range > Flag run; retain raw data
Study director told > Deviation and impact recorded
Repeat or exclude under approved criteria > Document decision

slides.title: What goes in the study record
bullets: Plate acceptance / control-validity decision and responsible scientist
Failed run and any repeat, with the reason; retain all original observations
Record departures as deviations; prospective plan changes require an authorised amendment, never retrospective relaxation of acceptance criteria
Exploratory in vitro results carry their actual quality status; GLP conclusions require the applicable approved plan and QA review

slides.title: Contacts
bullets: Lucia Moretti, GLP Quality Assurance and Archive Lead
